# A link that leaves the project is warned about, and never blocked (T5).

cd proj
exec metagente check boss.ag
stdout 'No problems found'
stderr 'Warning on line 3 of boss\.ag'
stderr 'points outside this project'

# a link inside the project is quiet
exec metagente check inside.ag
! stderr 'Warning'

# --strict turns the warning into a problem
! exec metagente check --strict boss.ag
stderr 'points outside this project'

-- proj/metagente.toml --
[runtime]
timeout_seconds = 30
-- proj/boss.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Helper from "../outside/helper.ag"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply Helper.hi
-- proj/inside.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Helper from "near/helper.ag"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply Helper.hi
-- proj/near/helper.ag --
agent Helper
  goal "h"
  accepts hi
  on hi
    reply "inside"
-- outside/helper.ag --
agent Helper
  goal "h"
  accepts hi
  on hi
    reply "outside"
